sn38.4:1.1: Kim atthi yam āvuso Sāriputta samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || || Dukkhassa kho āvuso pariññattham Bhagavati brahmacariyam vussatīti || || Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || || Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || || Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || ||
sn38.4:2.1: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa dukkhassa pariññāya || seyyathīdam || sammādiṭṭhi || pe || sammāsamādhi || ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāya || alañca panāvuso Sāriputta appamādāyāti || || Assāsapatto
